value.syntax: # [doc = " The disposition of a document at a reader."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " ```"] # [doc = " use pn_interchange::{NamespaceLabel, Rejection, Registry, Verdict};"] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " let verdict = Verdict::AcceptedStrictly { minor: 2 };"] # [doc = " assert!(verdict.is_accepted());"] # [doc = " assert!(!Verdict::Rejected(Rejection::UnheldMajor { major: 1 }).is_accepted());"] # [doc = " ```"] # [derive (Clone , Debug , PartialEq , Eq)] # [non_exhaustive] pub enum Verdict { # [doc = " The document satisfies the theory held at its stamp."] AcceptedStrictly { # [doc = " The stamped minor, which the reader holds."] minor : u64 , } , # [doc = " The stamp outruns the reader, and the document satisfies the"] # [doc = " companion of the reader's floor."] AcceptedTolerantly { # [doc = " The reader's floor: its ceiling of that major."] floor : u64 , } , # [doc = " The document is rejected, and here is why."] Rejected (Rejection) , }
